caption: The drawing consists of a single spoon positioned horizontally with the bowl on the left and the handle on the right, resting on a plain, lightly textured background. The spoon is rendered in shades of gray, appearing metallic with detailed highlights and shadows to suggest its reflective surface. The handle of the spoon displays engraved decorative motifs and the letters "IN" along with an ornamental design resembling a crest or emblem. The shadow of the spoon falls predominantly below and to the left, adding a sense of three-dimensionality. In the lower right corner of the drawing, the names "Walton" and "Kalaman" are written in capital letters, stacked one above the other. The entire composition is monochromatic, executed in graphite or pencil on a light, cream-colored paper.
title: Silver Teaspoon
